To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
hardware assistance can eliminate most overheads but not all, and that there are still significant overheads when disk I/O is involved.

1) CPU overheads are significantly lower with VT enabled than without; 2) CPU overheads remain non-negligibly high even with VT enabled; 3) Network I/O overheads are eliminated with VT and SR-IOV enabled; 4) Disk I/O overheads remain high even with VT and SRIOV enabled.
